summary: Timed main calls the dispatcher once per CLI iteration and synchronizes before stop clock. The full called dispatcher chooses among six TPR launch paths, each routed through its own generated stub to cudaLaunchKernel. Each selected kernel covers rows and full CSR slices, reduces and stores; inputs are copied before timing.
